title: Access application declared with elicited hostname or self-hosted-app id and elicited policy shape
asA: operator applying the edge-cloudflare-access v1.0.0 blueprint
iWant: the blueprint to elicit either an Access application hostname or a self-hosted-app id (one of the two), plus a policy shape from the enum
soThat: the apply record captures the exact Access application declaration the operator will issue in the Zero Trust dashboard or over the API

acceptanceCriteria.description: blueprint.json elicits access-application-host (kind string) and access-selfhosted-app-id (kind string; the operator supplies exactly one), plus access-audience (kind string), access-jwks-url (kind string), access-policy-shape (kind enum with options email-domain, service-token-only, service-token-plus-email-domain, group-membership; recommended default email-domain) and access-bypass-service-auth-id (kind string; blank disables break-glass). Applying the blueprint records the elicited values on rcf/blueprints/edge-cloudflare-access.applied.json. Applying agent sets: the applying agent picks exactly one of access-application-host or access-selfhosted-app-id, sets access-audience, access-jwks-url, one of the four access-policy-shape enum values, and (optionally) an access-bypass-service-auth-id.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the apply verb runs against a fixture project
acceptanceCriteria.then: rcf/blueprints/edge-cloudflare-access.applied.json carries the elicited values plus appliedCapabilities=[zeroTrustGate]

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given neither access-application-host nor access-selfhosted-app-id is supplied at apply time, when the applying agent runs apply, the apply verb refuses with a stable validation code apply.application-declaration-missing naming both elicit ids and writes no sidecar.
acceptanceCriteria.given: blueprint.json elicits access-application-host and access-selfhosted-app-id, both empty at apply time
acceptanceCriteria.then: apply refuses with code apply.application-declaration-missing and rcf/blueprints/edge-cloudflare-access.applied.json is not written

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given both access-application-host AND access-selfhosted-app-id are supplied at apply time, when the applying agent runs apply, the apply verb refuses with a stable validation code apply.application-declaration-ambiguous naming both elicit ids and writes no sidecar.
acceptanceCriteria.given: blueprint.json elicits access-application-host and access-selfhosted-app-id, both non-empty at apply time
acceptanceCriteria.then: apply refuses with code apply.application-declaration-ambiguous and rcf/blueprints/edge-cloudflare-access.applied.json is not written
